instruction: Please open the Account Settings page in Thunderbird. I want to access the email account configuration, not the general application preferences.

command: import pyatspi; import time; apps = [app for app in pyatspi.Registry.getDesktop(0) if 'Thunderbird' in app.name]; tb = apps[0] if apps else None; tabs = []; [tabs.extend([child for child in item]) if item.getRoleName() == 'page tab list' else None for item in tb] if tb else None; account_settings_tab = next((tab for tab in tabs if 'Account Settings' in tab.name), None); account_settings_tab.queryAction().doAction(0) if account_settings_tab else None; time.sleep(0.5)
